name: Swissotel The Stamford Singapore
short_description: A 1,252-room, I.M. Pei-designed tower above City Hall MRT -- the world's tallest hotel when it opened in 1986 -- with a Level 65 Lounge overlooking Marina Bay.
ai_summary: Swissotel The Stamford is a 1,252-room, I.M. Pei-designed tower rising 226 metres above City Hall MRT station within the Raffles City complex -- the tallest hotel in the world when it opened in 1986. Guests consistently praise the prime, transit-connected location, spacious Swiss Marina Bay View rooms with skyline views, and a strong breakfast spread at Clove and the Asian Market Cafe, alongside the Level 65 Lounge's 360-degree views over Marina Bay. The lounge no longer serves food during evening drinks (a pre-pandemic perk that hasn't returned) and vegetarian options there are limited, but repeat guests consistently call the hotel strong value for its location and facilities.

elite_benefits: Complimentary breakfast or lounge access for ALL Diamond members at participating hotels, per ALL - Accor Live Limitless program terms
Room upgrades for Platinum and Diamond members, subject to availability
Late check-out until 4pm for Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: 1,252 rooms in an I.M. Pei-designed tower directly above City Hall MRT -- the world's tallest hotel when it opened in 1986
Spacious 40-square-metre Swiss Marina Bay View rooms with skyline and harbour views
Level 65 Lounge offers 360-degree views over Marina Bay, a prime vantage point for the National Day Parade
Strong breakfast spread at Clove and the Asian Market Cafe, with fresh-squeezed juice and international/local dishes
Complimentary gym and shared pool facilities with Marina Bay Sands views
cons: The Level 65 Lounge no longer serves food during evening drinks, a perk that hasn't returned since before the pandemic
Limited vegetarian options at the executive lounge
As one of Singapore's largest hotels, the sheer scale can feel less intimate than smaller luxury properties
research_highlights: Guests, including repeat visitors, consistently call the hotel great value for its central, transit-connected location
The Swiss Marina Bay View rooms and skyline views draw repeated, strong praise
Breakfast at Clove and the Asian Market Cafe is a recurring highlight
research_watchouts: Evening drinks at the Level 65 Lounge no longer include the food service some guests remember from before the pandemic
Vegetarian guests may find lounge food options limited

faqs.question: How tall is Swissotel The Stamford Singapore?
faqs.answer: It's 226 metres (741 feet) tall and was the tallest hotel in the world when it opened in 1986, designed by architect I.M. Pei -- it remains one of Singapore's tallest buildings and one of its tallest hotels today.

faqs.question: Does Swissotel The Stamford have an executive lounge?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the Level 65 Lounge offers 360-degree views over Marina Bay and the city skyline, available to suite guests and eligible ALL - Accor Live Limitless elite members, though it currently doesn't serve food during evening drinks.
